title: Shulker shells craft
description: This datapack adds a craft of shulker shell.
body:
Tired of the endless hunt for Shulker Shells? Wish there was a more reliable way to get your hands on these essential inventory-expanding items? Well, your wish has been granted!

This new datapack introduces a simple yet incredibly useful feature: craftable Shulker Shells! No more trekking through dangerous End Cities hoping for a lucky drop. Now, you can craft your very own Shulker Shells right from your crafting table.
